title: 图标与界面元素含义不清
description: 用于选择动作的图标令人困惑，难以理解，部分图标无实际作用；设置菜单中的全屏选项仅以无标签图标呈现，界面整体不够清晰。
evidence: some of the icons which are used for selecting things, i.e pouring wine or eating bread are a little confusing
I could barely make out what the icons meant and many of them doesn't lead anywhere.
